title: Pack Pucks: An Open, Reproducible Platform for Peer-to-Peer SX1280 LoRa Ranging and a Field Comparison of Its Bandwidth Extremes
description: Firmware, offload and quality-control tools, raw field datasets and analysis scripts for Pack Pucks, an open platform for peer-to-peer time-of-flight ranging with the Semtech SX1280 2.4 GHz LoRa transceiver on off-the-shelf LILYGO T3-S3 (ESP32-S3) boards. The release contains everything behind the Part 1 preprint: the campaign firmware, the raw CSVs of the 22 August 2026 matched session at 406.25 and 1625 kHz (static and hand-held tiers, ten tape-surveyed markers from 30 to 300 m), the operator plan files and stopwatch lap logs, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure.
